findings.current: “No. I’m not leaving you out. I have no intention of leaving you out. Go back.”
findings.defect: “Go back” reverses the instruction to accompany Jin and conflicts with Jin’s repeated refusal to leave Genji behind.
findings.rationale: Keeps Jin’s emphatic repetition while making the order consistent with the party that sets out west.
findings.replacement: “No. I’m not leaving you out. I have no intention of leaving you out. You’re coming with us.”
findings.source: Chapter 811, Jin’s reply to Yamamoto Genji after assigning the westward party

summary: The reading copies and active state largely agree on the reveal, the westward pursuit, and the unresolved questions. One line in Chapter 811 contradicts the order Jin has just given.
